facts.fact: The ministry's Déclaration de politique sectorielle for the digital economy sets its strategic orientations to 2021, the horizon at which the President wants Benin to be West Africa's digital platform; the document gives no date of its own, so its published date 2017-02-01 is used.
facts.system: Déclaration de politique sectorielle: Orientations stratégiques 2021 dans le secteur de l'économie numérique

facts.fact: The full declaration is hosted as a PDF on the government's innovation.gouv.bj site; the document gives no date of its own, so its published date 2017-02-01 is used.
